title: 4 寻灵兔56 试炼
content_zh:
奔逃了一阵，洛豪也出了森林，此时洛豪的眼前忽然出现了两条道路，道路交叉点处有一块石碑，洛豪看到了石碑上的介绍，一条路通往山脉深处，另一条路则通往一座修士城。
石碑上清楚的介绍到，这座山脉被称作横断山脉，而修士城名为横断城。
洛豪此时已经是快要突破，何况他对此地人生地不熟，自然不愿意选择去横断城，所以他毫不犹豫的选择了前往横断山脉。
洛豪的选择无疑是最明智的，因为在洛豪逃亡横断山脉不久之后，向天就出了森林，来到了这个交叉口。
匆匆看了石碑一眼，向天就确定洛豪前往了横断城，二话不说就往横断城追去。
身为中洲的大云刀宫的长老，自然清楚横断山脉的地势，横断山脉深处是禁地，别说是他，就是聚婴实力的修真者也不敢轻易进入横断山脉。
向天检查了向阳的伤口也能清晰的判断出来杀了他儿子的人实力并不高，最多不过凝元中期，向天对自己的儿子实力还是清楚的。
普通的凝元初期根本杀不了他的儿子，而且有他向天的威名在，也没有人敢随便杀了他儿子。
所以能杀掉他儿子的应该是外来的修士或者散修，实力也比他的儿子高不了多少。
而横断山脉深处一年四季都被瘴气笼罩，这种瘴气即便是成丹实力的修真者也不能呆多久，更不要说凝元实力的修真者了，进去呆不上几分钟便可中毒死亡。
而且横断山脉深处还有许多有毒的灵兽与植物，一旦被这些灵兽或者植物围堵，就算是聚婴实力的高手也很难逃出来，这才是向天没有选择往横断山脉深处追杀的原因。
但是洛豪并不知道横断山脉深处的情况，直到来到瘴气笼罩的外围边缘，看着那黑压压一片的气体，洛豪才发现自己选错了路。
但是此时洛豪已经等不及了，因为洛豪终于忍不住要突破了。
坐在原地，洛豪开始凝聚真气进行修炼，真气在洛豪的胸口不停的进行周天运转，一圈、二圈，挡住洛豪结真后期的那层经脉薄膜似乎越来越脆弱，冲击，只要再冲击一下。
洛豪现在已经没有别的心思，只想冲破那一层薄膜。
此时洛豪体内的真气已经达到了一个临界点，洛豪长啸一声，终于，洛豪感受到体内的数处经脉“轰“的一声。
然后整个人就好像沐浴在温泉中一样清爽无比，与此同时无尽新生的真气开始从丹田涌起，一切是那么的自然清晰。
感受到结真后期强大的实力，洛豪甚至想找一个人来切磋一番。
如果现在再让他和那个向阳战斗一番，他觉得他绝对不会被向阳打成重伤，甚至可以和向阳势均力敌，如果不是向阳太想要他身上的储物袋而对他轻视，他根本就不可能杀掉向阳。
可是他在那个时候已经无从选择了，因为逃也逃不掉只有置之死地而后生了，可是现在洛豪有自信，就算是打不过向阳，也能从向阳的手中轻松逃掉。

至于正阳剑宗的李彦龙，洛豪根本就不放在眼里，这只不过是一个靠丹药堆积起来的纨绔少爷罢了，真实战斗力恐怕连稍微强一点的结真初期都能轻易打败他。
感受到实力的提升，洛豪的心情有些喜悦，因为这距离他为师傅报仇又更近了一步。
只是眼下，洛豪还不知应该怎么办，尽管他现在没有了那种淡淡的危机感，但是也不敢掉以轻心。
说不定那个向阳背后的人现在正在外面追杀他，一个向阳就差不多将他杀了，那要是向阳背后的人来了，那绝对是洛豪的噩梦。
所以洛豪决定在这里面先呆一段时间再出去。
……
横断城城门口，向天已经来到了这里，城门口的守卫也认识向天，知道这是和城主最要好的朋友，所以二话不说就打开了城门。
向天抬脚正要进去，忽然想起来他怎么这么笨，只要打听一下就知道杀了他儿子的人是否真的来了横断城，他似乎失算了。
“最近有没有新来的陌生修士来横断城?“
“回向长老，最近并没有什么外来陌生修士来横断城。“
一个守卫有些恭敬的回复。
向天的脸色开始变得难看起来。
杀了他儿子的人居然没有逃到横断城来，可是只有两条路啊，不是横断城就是横断山脉。
横断山脉？向天忽然脸色一变，开始往回向横断山脉深处遁去。
留下一脸莫名其妙的守卫，不过守卫很快反应过来，匆匆关了城门。
一路奔走，向天的脑子越发清晰了。
content_en:
After running for a while, Luo Hao also came out of the forest. At this time, two roads suddenly appeared in front of Luo Hao. There was a stone tablet at the intersection of the roads. Luo Hao saw the introduction on the stone tablet. One road led to the depths of the mountains, and the other road led to a monk city.
The stone tablet clearly introduces that this mountain range is called Hengduan Mountains, and the monk city is called Hengduan City.
Luo Hao was about to break through at this time, not to mention that he was not familiar with this place, so he naturally did not want to choose to go to Hengduan City, so he chose to go to the Hengduan Mountains without hesitation.
Luo Hao's choice was undoubtedly the wisest, because not long after Luo Hao fled to the Hengduan Mountains, Xiang Tian came out of the forest and came to this intersection.
After a quick glance at the stone tablet, Xiang Tian was sure that Luo Hao had gone to Hengduan City, and chased him towards Hengduan City without saying a word.
As the elder of the Great Cloud Blade Palace in Central Continent, he naturally knows the terrain of the Hengduan Mountains. The depths of the Hengduan Mountains are forbidden areas. Not to mention him, even cultivators with Ju Ying's strength dare not enter the Hengduan Mountains easily.
Xiangtian examined Xiangyang's wounds and could clearly tell that the person who killed his son was not very strong. He was only in the middle stage of Yuan Condensation at most. Xiangtian still knew his son's strength clearly.
Ordinary people in the early stage of Ning Yuan could not kill his son at all, and with his reputation to the sky, no one dared to kill his son casually.
Therefore, those who can kill his son should be outside monks or casual cultivators, and their strength is not much higher than his son.
The depths of the Hengduan Mountains are shrouded in miasma all year round. Even cultivators with the strength of Chengdan cannot stay in this miasma for long, let alone those with the strength of Ningyuan. They can be poisoned and die within a few minutes of entering.
Moreover, there are many poisonous spirit beasts and plants deep in the Hengduan Mountains. Once surrounded by these spirit beasts or plants, even a master of Juying strength would have a hard time escaping. This is why Xiang Tian did not choose to pursue them deep in the Hengduan Mountains.
But Luo Hao didn't know the situation deep in the Hengduan Mountains. It wasn't until he came to the outer edge of the miasma and looked at the black gas that Luo Hao realized that he had chosen the wrong path.
But at this time Luo Hao couldn't wait anymore, because Luo Hao finally couldn't help but break through.
Sitting there, Luo Hao began to gather his true energy to practice. The true energy circulated continuously in Luo Hao's chest, one and two circles. The meridians film that blocked Luo Hao's late stage of formation seemed to be getting more and more fragile, and all it took was one more impact.
Luo Hao has no other thoughts now, he just wants to break through the film.
At this time, the true energy in Luo Hao's body had reached a critical point. Luo Hao let out a long roar. Finally, Luo Hao felt a "boom" in several meridians in his body.
Then the whole person felt as refreshing as bathing in a hot spring. At the same time, endless new energy began to surge from the Dantian, and everything was so natural and clear.
Feeling the powerful strength of Jie Zhen in the later stage, Luo Hao even wanted to find someone to compare with.
If he was allowed to fight Xiang Yang again now, he felt that he would never be seriously injured by Xiang Yang, and could even be evenly matched with Xiang Yang. If Xiang Yang didn't despise him because he wanted the storage bag on him too much, he would never have been able to kill Xiang Yang.
But he had no choice at that time, because he couldn't escape and had to put himself to death. But now Luo Hao is confident that even if he can't defeat Xiang Yang, he can easily escape from Xiang Yang's hands.
As for Li Yanlong of the Zhengyang Sword Sect, Luo Hao didn't take it seriously at all. He was just a dandy young master who relied on pills. In terms of real combat power, even the slightly stronger Jie Zhen in the early stage could easily defeat him.
Feeling the improvement in strength, Luo Hao felt a little happy, because this was one step closer to avenging his master.
But right now, Luo Hao doesn't know what to do, even though he no longer has that faint sense of crisis., but don’t dare to take it lightly.
Maybe the person behind Xiang Yang is chasing him outside now, and Xiang Yang will almost kill him. If the person behind Xiang Yang comes, it will definitely be Luo Hao's nightmare.
So Luo Hao decided to stay here for a while before going out.
…
At the gate of Hengduan City, Xiang Tian had already arrived. The guard at the gate also knew Xiang Tian and knew that he was the best friend of the city lord, so he opened the gate without saying a word.
He raised his feet to the sky and was about to go in, when he suddenly remembered why he was so stupid. He could know if the person who killed his son had really come to Hengduan City just by asking. He seemed to have miscalculated.
"Have any new strange monks come to Hengduan City recently?"
"Returning to the elder, there have been no foreign monks coming to Hengduan City recently."
A guard replied somewhat respectfully.
Xiangtian's face began to look ugly.
The person who killed his son actually did not escape to Hengduan City, but there were only two roads, either Hengduan City or the Hengduan Mountains.
Hengduan Mountains? Xiang Tian's expression suddenly changed and he began to escape back to the depths of the Hengduan Mountains.
The guard was left with a puzzled look on his face, but the guard quickly reacted and hurriedly closed the city gate.
Running all the way, Xiangtian's mind became clearer and clearer.
